options.name: Keep current lifecycle/runtime coupling
options.correctness: Preserves behavior but leaves the final architecture debt unresolved.

options.name: Kernel neutral read and integrity contracts
options.correctness: Kernel owns only closed constants, digest integrity and read projections; Lifecycle continues to own semantic creation, freezing, state migration and Graph behavior; Runtime consumes Kernel without reverse Lifecycle imports.
options.complexity: Three small neutral modules, compatibility re-exports and import migration.
options.migration: Move one implementation for each pure contract to Kernel, re-export from Lifecycle, migrate Runtime imports and make debt tests accept final RESOLVED state.
options.rollback: Restore Lifecycle-local helpers and Runtime imports.
options.verification: AST boundary counterexample, object/result equivalence, digest tamper failure, complete Quick and real product journeys.

options.name: Merge Lifecycle and Runtime packages
options.correctness: Eliminates the graph cycle by collapsing distinct orchestration and execution responsibilities.
